name: Advanced Fields For Elementor Forms
author: hulkplugins

sections.description:
This is an all-in-one addon for Elementor Pro forms. It adds many extra features and advanced fields to improve your form-building experience with the Elementor form widget.

Free Fields

  • Color Field
  • Range Field
  • Datetime-local Field
  • Week Field
  • Month Field
  • Rich Text Field

Pro Fields

  • Rating Field
  • Slider Field
  • Color Picker Field
  • Currency Field
  • Select2 Field
  • Toggle Field
  • Unit Field
  • Telephone Field
  • Barcode Field
  • Signature Field
  • Dropzone Field
  • Calculator Field
  • Image Radio & Checkbox Fields
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation from the WordPress Dashboard

  1. Login to your admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins -> Add New
  3. Search Advanced Fields For Elementor Forms
  4. Click install and activate respectively.

Manual Installation from the WordPress Dashboard

If your server is not connected to the Internet, then you can use this method

  1. Download the plugin. A ZIP file will be downloaded.
  2. Login to your site\’s admin panel and navigate to Plugins -> Add New -> Upload.
  3. Click choose file, select the plugin file and click install

Install Using FTP

If you are unable to use any of the methods due to internet connectivity and file permission issues, then you can use
this method

  1. Download the plugin. A ZIP file will be downloaded.
  2. Unzip the file.
  3. Launch your favorite FTP client. Such as FileZilla, FireFTP, CyberDuck etc. If you are a more advanced user, then you
    can use SSH too.
  4. Upload the folder to wp-content/plugins/
  5. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  6. Navigate to Plugins -> Installed
  7. Activate the plugin
sections.faq:
What is this plugin, and what does it do?

This plugin is an all-in-one addon for Elementor Pro forms. It adds extra features and advanced fields to the Elementor form widget, making it easier to build complex, dynamic forms with enhanced functionality and customization options.

Do I need Elementor Pro to use this plugin?

Yes, this plugin is designed as an add-on for Elementor Pro. It adds features specifically to the Elementor Pro form widget, so you must have it installed and activated on your website for it to work.

What extra fields does this plugin add to the Elementor form widget?

This plugin includes several advanced form fields, such as color, range, and rich text Fields. Each field type is designed to improve the overall form-building experience.

Are there any compatibility issues with other plugins?

This plugin is built to work seamlessly with Elementor Pro and should work well with most plugins. However, if you encounter any conflicts, please ensure both Elementor Pro and this plugin are updated to their latest versions. You may also disable other plugins one by one to troubleshoot compatibility issues.

How do I get support if I encounter issues?

For support, please reach out through our official support page, available from your WordPress dashboard under Plugins > Support. You can also find answers in our online documentation and user community.
